policy.pair_key: lexicographically sorted installed-family names joined by ::
policy.coverage: Every unordered installed-family pair appears exactly once as an interface or explicit exclusion.
policy.exclusion_meaning: No designed installed contact, constraint, service path, or positive-volume B-rep intersection is present for this family pair.
policy.positive_intersection: Every intersection above volume_epsilon_mm3 must be an interface; a forbidden intersection must remain blocked.
policy.acceptance_boundary: Digital classification is not assembly acceptance; all nonblocked rows still require their named physical evidence owner.

geometry_observations.method: Exact CadQuery B-rep intersection across all 378 unordered installed-family pairs using the 38 final rigid release bodies in installed coordinates.
